items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Has Emile's playing ever changed? ... [INTERVIEWEE] It's always been that way, just he was more familiar with his horn when he was young.

ctx.x: And he never did play saxophone. Never did. Mm-hm. No. You ever worked with buddy Petit? I worked with them on the, with the alto sax.
Has Emile's playing ever changed? Has it ever changed or has it always been that way?
It's always been that way, just he was more familiar with his horn when he was young.
